properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 2:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 159 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a thunderstorm 7 miles
west of Saguache, or 45 miles southeast of Gunnison, moving east at
20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 40 to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Saguache, Bonanza, and Villa Grove.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 1:35PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 134 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from near La Veta to near Boncarbo to 8 miles south
of Segundo. Movement was east southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 40 to 50 mph and brief heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Trinidad, Walsenburg, La Veta, Aguilar, Cokedale, Starkville,
Gulnare, Spanish Peaks, Boncarbo, Segundo, Weston.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 1:32PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 131 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking gusty showers and storms
along a line extending from Monument to near Victor to 7 miles north
of Canon City. Movement was east southeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and brief rainfall.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Colorado Springs, Fountain, Monument, Air Force Academy, Manitou
Springs, Palmer Lake, Calhan, Green Mountain Falls, Victor, Ramah,
Hanover, Truckton, Yoder, Peyton, Security, Security-Widefield,
Falcon, Stratmoor, Chipita Park, and Gleneagle.
